title: Police appeal for help in locating Kibriya Ahmed after his children reported missing
excerpt: Kibriya Ahmed is wanted after his two children were reported missing. Police believe he may know their whereabouts.
body:
Police are seeking the public's assistance in locating Kibriya Ahmed, who is wanted after his two children were reported missing. The 42-year-old is believed to have breached a non-molestation order that prevents him from having unsupervised contact with his children, aged 12 and 15.

The children, Yousaf and Mohammed, were reported missing from Liversidge, Kirklees, on Saturday 24 October. Yousaf is described as 5ft 11ins tall, of medium build, with short black hair and black facial hair, while Mohammed is 4ft 9ins tall, slim, with short black hair and glasses.

Police have conducted extensive enquiries to locate Ahmed, who has connections to both Rochdale and Manchester. They believe he may know the whereabouts of his children and are now appealing to the public for help.

Anyone with information about Kibriya Ahmed's location is urged to contact West Yorkshire Police by calling 101 or reporting online via Live Chat, quoting reference 13260586098. Alternatively, information can be provided anonymously to Crimestoppers at 0800 555 111.
